list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An isostructural, discrete W36Ce3Ni2 polyoxometalate. Three B-α-SbW9O33 units and an in situ generated B-ε-NiW9O33 unit enclose a Ce3Ni(Sb4O4)(OAc)(H2O)8 core. The Sb4O4 fragment directs the core structure; its oxygen atoms bind the Ce centers. The two Ni centers are octahedral, and the three Ce centers are nine-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: Heat the trilacunary antimonotungstate precursor with nickel(II) chloride hexahydrate and cerium(III) nitrate hexahydrate in sodium acetate/acetic acid buffer at 80 °C. The nickel and cerium salts are each used at a 2:1 ratio relative to the precursor. Filter and slowly evaporate the mother liquor at room temperature.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration followed by slow evaporation of the mother liquor at room temperature.
synthesis.yield: Nearly 10 g of crystalline product per batch at 40-fold scale-up; isolated yield not stated in the main article.

source_locations.location: Section 3.1, Figure 1a–b; Ce congener shown in Figure 1c–g

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The single-crystal structure is isostructural with the Ce and Eu congeners. Its discrete W36La3Ni2 framework comprises three B-α-SbW9O33 units and an in situ generated B-ε-NiW9O33 unit surrounding an Ln3Ni(Sb4O4)(OAc)(H2O)8 core. Both Ni centers are six-coordinate and the three lanthanide centers are nine-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: Heat the trilacunary antimonotungstate precursor with nickel(II) chloride hexahydrate and lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate in sodium acetate/acetic acid buffer at 80 °C. The nickel and lanthanum salts are each used at a 2:1 ratio relative to the precursor. Filter and slowly evaporate the mother liquor at room temperature.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration followed by slow evaporation of the mother liquor at room temperature.
synthesis.yield: Nearly 10 g of crystalline product per batch at 40-fold scale-up; isolated yield not stated in the main article.
